measuredOn.note: The three fixture subjects hash identically at 7ac49140, b67e751f and the final code commit. Runs labelled after* ran at 7ac49140, hold-* at b67e751f, b8-* at the final code commit (which adds only the authority-sweep assertions), before* at the base.

rootCause.finding: Per-test process churn, not slow assertions. Each fixture model build committed a fresh git repository (init, two config, add, commit, rev-parse, plus a forked git maintenance); the core model test committed a twelve-process repository three times and spawned the bd CLI for every build without an injected work-item query.
rootCause.method: strace -f -e trace=execve over one file run alone, before the change and at 7ac49140; successful execs counted by argv prefix. Fixture-repository git counts exclude the observer's own git --no-optional-locks reads, counted separately.

spawns.note: The added test builds two models, one through the spawned bd default.

spawnCost.bdReadonlySqlInEmptyDirectory: 0.34-0.59 s each at load1 83.6 (three timed runs)

change: fixtureRepoWithGit commits one repository per test file and copies it per call (cpSync); commit instants were already pinned, so every copy carries the revision a fresh commit mints. A new test pins that revision as a literal derived by hand and checks distinct, clean copies and that a write stays in its own copy.

model.test.ts copies butlersGitFixture the same way, and answers the work-item query in-process (a throwing runner) unless a test supplies one; work-items.ts maps every query failure to the same Unknown. A new test keeps the spawned bd default and asserts the whole model equals the in-process one.
No assertion, timeout, retry or vitest setting changed; the global testTimeout stays 5000 ms.

protocol.host: 12 cores, shared with other lanes; vitest maxWorkers 50% (root config, #303)
protocol.burners: sh -c 'while :; do :; done' processes; the burners field is the count used. before8a, after8a and b8-*: exactly 8, plus ambient load from other lanes (the amended AC 2). before50a, after50-*: 8, topped up by 2 per 10 s before the run while load1 < 50 (cap 40). hold-*: 8, topped up by 2 per 10 s while load1 < 52 before and during the run (cap 40). The top-up runs predate the amendment and were stopped at the coordinator's request so as not to flood other lanes' gates.
protocol.load: load1 sampled every 15 s during the vitest run
protocol.defaultBudget: targetDefaultBudgetMaxMs covers only tests on the 5 s default; the accessibility variant and navigation-budget tests (240 s) and the proposal-disclosure Chrome test (45 s) carry their own budgets.
